title: Beautiful Riverfront Condo in Downtown Nashville
description:
Find inspiration in this Nashville-themed apartment located minutes from Broadway and historic Germantown. The curated interior features chic decor and furnishings, utilizing neutral tones with touches of color throughout. Guests will also enjoy an outdoor patio on the bank of the Cumberland River and unlimited access to pool, courtyard, and gym amenities. Come and enjoy all that Nashville has to offer in this newly-renovated retreat on the river.

The space
This is a private, 1 bedroom, ground-floor condo with a back patio featuring views of the Cumberland River. The condominum complex, Riverfront Condominiums, boasts shared spaces including a pool, a premium gym, a paid laundromat, and a courtyard with spaces for grilling, lounging, and a fire pit.

Guest access
Guests are welcome to use the entire condo.
